messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added reduced-motion overrides in [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css) and [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css). Cards now have no border transition, and the win banner appears static immediately. Normal motion remains unchanged.

I didn’t run tests.
